profile.headline: Software Developer at Principled Technologies
profile.summary: I am a software engineer who enjoys leadership positions while developing web or application platforms.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Leading development teams to make large projects
- Mentoring coworkers in different technologies
- Helping with project planning for both waterfall and iterative development projects
- Working with eLearning to help companies make courses that are 508 and WCAG 2.0 AA compliant
- Working with clients to help clarify requirements
- Developing responsive web applications
- Working with Wordpress to maintain some websites

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer, Application Lifecycle Management
positions.description:
Administer support for 2,000 users for Crucible, Jira, Stash, Clearcase, Jenkins, and Spotfire
Streamlined Jira onboarding process and documentation
Built up crucible and documented for new users 
Utilized Python to create scripts for automation of Crucible

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Trained in Spring, C#, Java, Javascript, SOAP, and Rest
Built on mobile website application
Managed user requirements
Performed code cleanup to lessen technical debt

positions.title: Systems Analyst Technical Intern
positions.description:
Acquired user requirements to create 8 use cases for application
Smoke tested tool during application release
Directed developed of adoption of best practices
Researched and adopted tools for more collaborative team use

positions.title: QA Technical Intern
positions.description:
Developed automated testing for two internal web applications with Visual basic
Led volunteer event of 30 volunteers
Presented final report to senior managers
